backend/scheduler.py::EOD_RETRY_MINUTES.source: Retry spacing for a failed EOD regime catch-up, hand-set 2026-10-16 (Niclas: retries before the open instead of trading on the previous posterior). With the launch at 08:20 ET and the 09:25 ET limit, 10 min gives the startup run plus up to 6 retries; the input fetch takes about 1.5 min, so retries do not overlap.

audit/checks_gate.py::C93_GAP_WINDOW_MIN.source: CHECK 93 (audit/CHECKS.md row 93; ruling Niclas 2026-10-20, classes amended 2026-10-21). A stop leg filled within 5 min of the 09:30 ET open is a gap only if that day's open was at or below the stop (alpaca.get_daily_open), as R7 (EXIT_PARITY.md) classed them; the 10-20 time-only version counted 18 gaps against R7's 7. Review at the first monthly read.

audit/checks_gate.py::C93_MIN_N.source: CHECK 93 (audit/CHECKS.md row 93; ruling Niclas 2026-10-20). A class needs 5 fills before its median is judged against the model; R7's gap class had 7. Reported, not judged, below it.

audit/checks_gate.py::C93_MODEL.source: CHECK 93 (audit/CHECKS.md row 93; ruling Niclas 2026-10-20). The engine's modelled stop slip, adverse: R7 medians from 44 live stop legs (EXIT_PARITY.md R7, 2026-10-17). Same values as port-regime exit_rules.STOP_SLIP_INTRADAY_PCT / STOP_SLIP_GAP_PCT; imported from there once port-regime merges.

audit/checks_gate.py::C93_TOLERANCE.source: CHECK 93 (audit/CHECKS.md row 93; ruling Niclas 2026-10-20). WARNING distance between the live median and the model: about the R7 intraday range half-width (-0.37..+1.13 %, so 0.25 pts) and the gap median itself (0.5 pts). Review at the first monthly read against the live spread.

backend/backtest/engine_fast.py::REGIME_.source: Any share in (0, 0.1) gives LR 1.0 under _lr_ipo_cluster's int(share * 10) step, for every sector count; 1/n does not (n <= 10 gives 1.2). The engine has no historical EDGAR feed, so IPO is neutral (floor_reconstruction.py precedent). Backtest-only: no live path reads it.
